---
title: "Ahmed Ke Aaj Ghar Mein, Kohraam Ik Bapa Hai,"
language: "Urdu"
lang: "ur"
direction: "ltr"
kalamType: "Noha"
tags: ["noUrdu"]
aliases: []
published: false
---

Ahmed Ke Aaj Ghar Mein, Kohraam Ik Bapa Hai,

Na Haq Jo Qatal e Zahra, Ummat Ne Kar Diya Hai,

Raatoun Ko Uth Ke Paani, Shabbir Ko Pilana,
Zainab Meray Hassan Ke, Tum Do Qafan Bana Na,
Zahra Ne Waqt e Rukhsat, Beti Se Yeh Kaha Hai,

Haq Maang Ne Jo Zahra, Darbar Mein Hai Aayi,
Haakim Ne Yeh Na Socha, Yeh Hai Rasool Jayi,
Kaha Masla e Wirasat, Gayi Bhool Fatima Hai,

Shabbir Ne Kaha Jo, Amma Mujhe Bulao,
Aayi Sada Qafan Se, Mera Hussain Ao,
Dono Lipat Ke Roye, Yaad Aayi Karbala Hai,

Aaya Mubahila Se, Waqif Agar Woh Hotay,
Jhutlatey Na Kabhi Woh, Zahra Ke Dono Betay,
Qur’aan Na Samajh Mein, Ummat Ke Aa Saka Hai,

item.command:
/bin/bash -lc "python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p = Path('src/data/lyrics/ahmed-ke-aaj-ghar-mein-kohraam-ik-bapa-hai-nw-723255f8dfe6.md')
_, metadata, body = p.read_text().split('---', 2)
roman = '\\n'.join(line[2:] for line in metadata.split('romanLyrics: |-\\n', 1)[1].splitlines())
for edition, numbers in [(roman, '1234'), (body, '۱۲۳۴')]:
    blocks = [block.splitlines() for block in edition.strip().split('\\n\\n')]
    assert [len(block) for block in blocks] == [2, 4, 4, 4, 4]
    assert [block[0] for block in blocks[1:]] == list(numbers)
assert 'direction: \"rtl\"' in metadata and 'noUrdu' not in metadata
print('Verified a two-verse opening and four three-verse stanzas in both editions.')
PY"

I read “Aaya Mubahila” as `آیۂ مباہلہ`.
